scheme_name: Scheme of Internship of Students to DRDO Labs/Estts for Project Training
other_conditions: Interns will be permitted access only to UNCLASSIFIED areas of DRDO Labs/Establishments.
The provisions of the Apprentices Act, 1961, do not apply to this scheme.
DRDO is under no obligation to offer employment to students upon completion of their training.
Applications are to be made through the respective institutes or colleges by contacting the concerned laboratories or establishments, subject to vacancy availability and Lab Director approval.
benefits_summary: Provides internship training in DRDO projects, offering exposure to defense-related research and development activities.
